summary: Dependency-aware StepScheduler is implemented as agent_core::scheduler. It validates PlanSpec DAGs before freeze, rejects missing dependencies and cycles, selects deterministic ready steps from AuditJournal-backed CommitSealed evidence, keeps execution sequential-first with an explicit read-only parallelism extension point in explanations, blocks denied dependency chains, and fails closed when retry budget is exhausted.

acceptance.criterion: Scheduler returns only steps whose dependencies are sealed or explicitly satisfied.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::scheduler::tests::linear_plan_waits_for_commit_sealed_not_observation_only verifies observation refs alone do not satisfy dependencies; CommitSealed with matching parameter_hash is required. agent_core::scheduler::tests::current_step_cannot_bypass_unsealed_dependency verifies current_step_id cannot bypass an unsealed prerequisite.

agent_core::scheduler::tests::missing_dependency_and_cycle_are_rejected covers SchedulerError::Cycle, and agent_core::scheduler::tests::planner_validation_rejects_cyclic_plan_before_freeze verifies Planner validation rejects the plan before freeze.

acceptance.criterion: Dependent steps do not run after denied prerequisite steps.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::scheduler::tests::denied_dependency_blocks_dependent_step produces SchedulerDecisionKind::Blocked with FailedClosed terminal_state after an ApprovalBound denial for the prerequisite.

acceptance.criterion: Retry budget exhaustion moves the run to Suspended or FailedClosed.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::scheduler::tests::retry_budget_exhaustion_fails_closed records an unsealed EffectPrepared attempt and receives SchedulerDecisionKind::RetryExhausted with FailedClosed terminal_state.

acceptance.criterion: Scheduler output is deterministic for the same PlanRun.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::scheduler::tests::branched_plan_selection_is_deterministic_and_explained snapshots SchedulerDecision::to_json for a branched plan, including ready step order and explanation.

source_of_truth: AuditJournal CommitSealed events with matching step_id and parameter_hash for dependency satisfaction
AuditJournal ApprovalBound denial summaries for denied dependency blocking
AuditJournal EffectPrepared minus CommitSealed/RollbackObserved for retry exhaustion
integration_points: Planner validate_plan rejects missing dependencies and cycles before freeze
AgentCore advance_run uses SchedulerDecision before policy evaluation
AgentCore post-seal completion check uses SchedulerDecision instead of observation-only next-step selection
runtime_contract.execution_policy: Sequential-first. Safe read-only parallelism is documented as an explanation extension point and is not enabled in this task.
